locator: I q.103 a.6 co.: in its execution, He governs some things by means of others
interpretation: In the execution of government God governs some things by means of others, making some 'causes of others in government'. Read as transitivity of direction along movers: whoever moves a director directs, through it, what it directs, to the same end. Interpretive: a.6 speaks of the first governor's use of intermediaries; the reading extends this to every mover of a director, as the prima via does for every mover of a mover. Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
